header: This file talks to Google's embedding model. I keep the database and the TypeORM entities out of it on purpose: a standalone script (such as scripts/test-eds-query.ts or scripts/reingest-circulars-gemini.ts, run with tsx) can import this without loading the entity classes, whose decorators need TypeScript's emitDecoratorMetadata and so cannot run under tsx. embedding.service.ts re-exports everything below, so existing imports are unchanged.

symbols.name: normalizeVector
doc: I normalize an embedding vector to unit length.

symbols.name: QUERY_EMBEDDING_TTL_MS
doc: One omnibar question is embedded by up to five search engines (policy / content search, announcements, holiday policy, headline search). They run in parallel with the SAME text, so without sharing, a single question costs up to five identical Google calls. Under load (or a test run) that exhausts the per-minute allowance and the failed calls silently turn into empty search results.

Here I make identical (text, taskType) requests share ONE in-flight call and its result for a few minutes. I never cache a FAILED call. I cache only search queries; document embeddings at ingestion are all distinct and are not.

doc: I generate a 768-dimensional embedding vector directly via the Google Gemini API.

behaviours: the request: model gemini-embedding-001, 768 dimensions, key in the URL
the DEFAULT task type is RETRIEVAL_QUERY (what an upload uses, so a re-read matches it)
search_document uses RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT and is never cached (two calls = two requests)
two identical queries at once share ONE request and one answer
a 429 is retried (waiting as told) and then succeeds
a 5xx is retried and then succeeds
a network error is retried and then succeeds
a 400 is NOT retried and says what happened
an answer without numbers is a fatal error, not a silent empty vector
a FAILED query is never cached: the next identical call tries again
without GEMINI_API_KEY it fails clearly before any request
normalizeVector gives unit length (3,4 -> 0.6,0.8), and a zero vector gives no NaN
GUARD: geminiEmbedding.ts imports no database and no entities: its one import is the pure word-family file (src/lib/search/termFamilies.ts, which imports nothing)
embedding.service.ts re-exports generateEmbedding and normalizeVector, so every existing import still works
